name: wpilog-analyzer
description: AI-powered FRC robot log analysis via MCP. Analyzes .wpilog telemetry from the roboRIO.

viewsWelcome.contents: Open a log in WPILog Explorer to list its entries: click one in the Logs view, or double-click a `.wpilog` file.

wpilog-mcp.logDirectory.markdownDescription: Path to the directory containing `.wpilog` files. Leave blank to auto-detect. Set it in your User settings for every project; a project's own (Workspace) setting overrides it there. A path starting with `~/` is in your home folder, on macOS, Linux, and Windows alike (`~/riologs`); write paths with forward slashes, which work on every system. A relative path is a folder inside the project.

wpilog-mcp.additionalLogDirectories.markdownDescription: More directories of `.wpilog` files, listed and searched along with **Log Directory** (for example an archive drive, or logs another team published). As there, `~/` is your home folder on every system, and forward slashes work everywhere. A relative path is a folder inside the project (for example, if your robot code writes simulation logs to a `logs` folder, `logs` lists them). A project's own (Workspace) list replaces your User list there. REV logs are matched to a wpilog only within the directory that holds it.

wpilog-mcp.teamNumber.markdownDescription: Your FRC team number, for The Blue Alliance match data when a log does not record one. Empty until you set it. A project's own (Workspace) setting overrides your User setting there.

wpilog-mcp.tbaApiKey.markdownDescription: Your read API key from [thebluealliance.com/account](https://www.thebluealliance.com/account), for match data. Paste it here, in your **User** settings: a few seconds later the extension moves it into VS Code's secret storage (your operating system's keychain) and clears this field, which shows empty once you leave it, so the key never stays in a settings file. The field shows no key even when one is stored. Paste a new key to replace it, or [remove the stored key](command:wpilog-mcp.clearTbaApiKey). To enter the key without it showing on screen, run [Set The Blue Alliance API Key](command:wpilog-mcp.setTbaApiKey).

wpilog-mcp.enableForClaudeCode.markdownDescription: **Claude Code only** (Copilot and other VS Code agents always have the server). Make WPILog Analyzer available to Claude Code, which finds servers in a project's `.mcp.json` rather than in VS Code: the extension adds a `wpilog-analyzer` entry to the `.mcp.json` of each WPILib robot project you open, and keeps any existing entry up to date. For a folder that is not a robot project, run **WPILog Analyzer: Add to Claude Code in This Folder**. The entry holds this computer's paths, so it is never written into a `.mcp.json` that git tracks, and the extension offers to add `.mcp.json` to `.gitignore`. The TBA API key is never written into it.

wpilog-mcp.useStandaloneServer.markdownDescription: Use the [standalone install](https://github.com/TripleHelixProgramming/wpilog-mcp/blob/main/doc/STANDALONE.md)'s server instead of the extension's own: the `http` server of `~/.wpilog-mcp/servers.yaml`, shared by VS Code's agents, Claude Code, WPILog Explorer, and other clients. If missing, the extension offers to install its bundled server. A new configuration is seeded with the User **Log Directory**, **Additional Log Directories**, and **Team Number**, never the TBA key. Existing configuration is kept. Afterward that file controls the server: project directories and these settings, including **Java Path**, **WPILib Year**, **Max Heap**, and **Idle Exit Minutes**, do not configure it. Java and heap settings are used to run the installer. On activation an older launcher (by version numbers) is updated when this setting is on or the extension installed it before; the JAR never downgrades, and the next start replaces the running server. [Install Standalone Server](command:wpilog-mcp.installStandaloneServer) also works with this setting off. Claude Code's entry runs the install's bridge (`connect http`); [Show Server Log](command:wpilog-mcp.showServerLog) opens `~/.wpilog-mcp/logs/http.log`.

wpilog-mcp.javaPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `java` executable. Leave blank to auto-detect the WPILib JDK.

wpilog-mcp.wpiLibYear.markdownDescription: WPILib installation year (e.g., `2026`). Leave blank to auto-detect the latest installed year.

wpilog-mcp.idleExitMinutes.markdownDescription: How many minutes a server keeps running with no client connected before it exits on its own. `0` keeps it running until [Restart Server](command:wpilog-mcp.restartServer) or the next update. VS Code's agents, Claude Code, and the extension start a server again whenever they need it, so a short time costs only a few seconds' wait the next time.
